concept: A single elegant enclosing arch cradling two small abstract forms representing parent and baby. Architectural shelter, minimal geometric negative space.
A softly woven abstract nest made of three clean curved strokes protecting one central seed shape. Calm care and privacy, very simple scalable silhouette.
A rounded rectangular pod doorway with an abstract N formed by its negative space. Architectural precision and warm welcoming proportions.
Two interlocking curved forms making a subtle heart and protective embrace without literal anatomy. Confident minimal symbol, memorable at small sizes.
A distinctive folded leaf enclosing a tiny circle, subtly shaped like a private pod. Natural calm, balanced asymmetrical silhouette.
